en.titre:
GLOW UP HACKS
EVERY MAN
SHOULD KNOW.

en.texte: Book a haircut every 3 to 4 weeks. Ask your barber for a shape that suits your face, not the trend.
Fit beats brand. Shoulder seams on your shoulders, sleeves that hug your arms. A plain black tee never fails.
The mistake is starting too fast, then quitting. A running coach app like Atala tells you when to slow down.
Trim every few days and clean up your neckline. Even stubble looks intentional when the lines are clean.
One scent you wear every day. Two sprays on your neck or wrists is enough, never a cloud.
